The data layer is the `store` package, where persistent entities are declared as plain structs alongside their `Find*`/`Update*`/`Delete*` query types:

Counting distinct Go packages outside `store/**` that reference each type by its qualified name:

| Entity | Packages outside `store` | Total references |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `User` (`store/user.go`) | 7 | 99 |
| `Memo` (`store/memo.go`) | 6 | 73 |
| `Attachment` (`store/attachment.go`) | 4 | 43 |
| `Inbox`, `MemoRelation`, `MemoShare` | 3 each | 10–14 |
| `Reaction`, `UserIdentity` | 2 each | 9–14 |
| `IdentityProvider`, `InstanceSetting`, `UserSetting` | 1 each | 6–11 |

`store.User` appears in `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/rss`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/auth`, and `server/notification`. `store.Memo` covers the same set minus `server/auth` and `server/router/fileserver`, plus `server/runner/memopayload`.

Two caveats on the counts: `server/router/api/v1/test` is a separate test package for the v1 API, so if you fold it into `server/router/api/v1` the totals become 6 and 5 respectively — the ranking is unchanged. All references are unaliased (`github.com/usememos/memos/store`), so no qualified names were missed.
